name: Advanced Topics in Syntax
description:
The objective of this seminar course is to familiarize students with new developments that are taking place in the area of syntax and semantics.
The course may introduce students to the following topics (but not limited to):
1. Honorification.
2. Allocutivity.
3. Split constructions.
6. Indexicals.
7. Discourse particles.
8. Counting and plurality.
9. (In)definiteness.
10. Event structure.
The topics for a particular semester will be decided by the instructor(s).
